info.title: Azure AI Gateway
info.description: Focused Azure CLI contract for AI Gateway resources hosted on Microsoft.ApiManagement/service. The broader API Management surface is intentionally excluded.

tags.name: AI Gateways
tags.description: Create and manage AI Gateway resources.

tags.name: Model Providers
tags.description: Create and manage Foundry and custom model providers.

tags.name: Models
tags.description: Create and manage models exposed through AI Gateway.

tags.name: MCP Tool Servers
tags.description: Create and manage MCP tool servers and their inline sources.

tags.name: Networking
tags.description: Configure gateway networking and manage service-side private endpoint connections.

get.description: Lists model providers registered in an AI Gateway workspace.

put.summary: Create or replace a model provider
put.description: Creates or replaces a Foundry or custom model provider registration.

204.description: The model provider does not exist.

get.description: Lists AI Gateway resources in a subscription. The CLI must filter the ARM response before returning output because the backing operation also returns other API Management SKUs.

get.summary: List AI gateways by resource group
get.description: Lists AI Gateway resources in a resource group. The CLI must filter the ARM response before returning output because the backing operation also returns other API Management SKUs.

put.summary: Create or replace an AI gateway
put.description: Creates an AI Gateway using the fixed AIGateway SKU.

patch.description: Updates AI Gateway tags or managed identity.

204.description: The AI Gateway does not exist.

get.description: Lists API key metadata without returning key values.
Gets metadata for one API key without returning key values.

put.description: Creates a gateway-wide data-plane API key. Retrieve its generated values through listSecrets.

delete.description: Deletes a gateway-wide data-plane API key.

204.description: The API key does not exist.

post.description: Returns the primary and secondary data-plane key values. Treat the response as secret material.

200.description: The primary and secondary key values.

post.description: Rotates the primary data-plane key value. Call list-secrets to retrieve the new value.
Rotates the secondary data-plane key value. Call list-secrets to retrieve the new value.

get.description: Lists the service-side private endpoint connections of an AI Gateway. Create the backing private endpoint with az network private-endpoint.
Gets one service-side private endpoint connection of an AI Gateway.

put.summary: Approve or reject a private endpoint connection
put.description: Sets the approval state of a service-side private endpoint connection. The request must include the connection resource ID and privateLinkServiceConnectionState; the backing private endpoint is a separate resource created with az network private-endpoint.

200.description: The private endpoint connection was updated.

delete.description: Removes a service-side private endpoint connection. The backing Microsoft.Network private endpoint is a separate resource and is not deleted.

200.description: The private endpoint connection was deleted.

204.description: The private endpoint connection does not exist.

get.description: Lists registered models across every provider in an AI Gateway workspace.
Lists registered models under one model provider.

put.description: Creates or replaces a model registration under a model provider.

patch.description: Updates mutable model registration fields, including inline policies. Send If-Match with the ETag from a prior get to reject stale policy updates.

412.description: The resource changed after it was read.

204.description: The model registration does not exist.

get.description: Lists MCP tool server registrations in an AI Gateway workspace.
Gets an MCP tool server registration. Secret-bearing endpoint fields are redacted.

put.summary: Create or replace an MCP tool server
put.description: Creates or replaces an MCP tool server registration and its inline sources.

200.description: The MCP tool server was replaced.

201.description: The MCP tool server registration was created.

412.description: The resource changed after it was read.

patch.description: Updates an MCP tool server. Source array updates must preserve redacted secrets. Send If-Match with the ETag from a prior get to reject stale source updates.

200.description: The MCP tool server was updated.

412.description: The resource changed after it was read.

delete.description: Deletes an MCP tool server registration.

200.description: The MCP tool server registration was deleted.

204.description: The MCP tool server registration does not exist.

post.summary: Get MCP tool server secrets for safe updates
post.description: Returns secret-bearing endpoint fragments for a concurrency-safe source update. CLI output must remain suppressed unless a future explicit secret-output command is approved.

ETag.description: Resource version that must match the companion GET.

post.summary: Get OAuth login links for an MCP source
post.description: Starts an OAuth authorization-code connection for one persisted MCP source.

EndpointIdParameter.name: endpointId
EndpointIdParameter.description: Server-generated identifier of a persisted MCP source.

IfMatchParameter.name: If-Match
IfMatchParameter.description: Resource ETag used to reject stale updates.

AIGatewayUpdateProperties.description: The networking properties that can be PATCHed on an AI Gateway. Other properties are immutable after create or are read-only.

AIGatewaySkuProperties.description: Fixed AI Gateway SKU. Other API Management SKUs are excluded.

PublicNetworkAccess.description: Whether public network access is allowed for the gateway. If 'Disabled', private endpoints are the exclusive access method. Default value is 'Enabled'.

VirtualNetworkType.description: Outbound VNet integration mode for the gateway. 'None' means the gateway is not joined to a virtual network. 'External' joins the gateway to the delegated subnet in virtualNetworkConfiguration so it can reach private backends; the gateway remains reachable on its public and private endpoints. 'Internal' is a service-managed value this extension does not set.

VirtualNetworkConfiguration.description: Delegated subnet used for outbound VNet integration. subnetResourceId is the only writable field.

subnetResourceId.description: Full resource ID of the delegated integration subnet.

PrivateEndpointConnectionStatus.description: Approval status of a private endpoint connection.

PrivateLinkServiceConnectionState.description: Approval state of the connection between the private endpoint and the gateway.

description.description: Reason for approval or rejection of the connection.

AIGatewayPrivateEndpoint.description: Reference to the backing Microsoft.Network/privateEndpoints resource. Created and deleted separately with az network private-endpoint.

AIGatewayPrivateEndpointConnectionUpdate.description: The only property a caller can set when approving or rejecting a private endpoint connection.

displayName.description: Human-friendly label for the API key.

AIGatewayModelProviderWriteProperties.description: Model provider settings. Foundry providers use foundry; custom providers use custom.

AIGatewayModelProviderUpdateProperties.description: Mutable model provider settings. Provider kind is immutable.

AIGatewayInlinePolicy.description: Inline AI Gateway policy. Fields other than type depend on the selected policy type. Documented first-class types are tokenLimit (period, count, counterKey) and contentSafety (hateSeverity, selfHarmSeverity, sexualSeverity, violenceSeverity). This schema stays open-ended so other policy types pass through unchanged.
